name: Wooclap
summary: Interactive presentation and audience-response tool for classes, trainings and meetings, with AI question and brainstorming features on Pro.
description: Interactive presentation and audience-response tool for classes, trainings and meetings, with AI question and brainstorming features on Pro.

pricing.details: Two official public ladders, amounts billed annually and stated excluding VAT. Monthly list prices besides these annually billed figures were not extracted and are left unlisted. Official prices already in euro, shown as published. Education: Starter Free, no credit card — 5 questions/month, 21 question types, live sessions, no AI. Basic 7 €/month billed annually excl. VAT — unlimited questions, no AI. Pro 15 € per presenter / month billed annually excl. VAT — AI features (question builder, image labeling, question diversifier, brainstorming suggestions/summaries and follow-up questions). A presenter is someone who can present content and receive answers; the plan admin counts as a presenter (participants do not). Campus is custom (request a quote), starting from 6 presenters, with AI. Business: Starter Free, no credit card — 5 questions/month, no AI. Basic 12 €/month billed annually excl. VAT — unlimited questions, no AI. Pro 25 € per month / presenter billed annually excl. VAT — AI features. Corporate is custom (request a quote), starting from 6 presenters, with AI. Official note: Wooclap does not use user-generated content or personal data to train AI models; AI-related features can be disabled in the account.
